newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS FALL AT START, SEEN JITTERY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS FALL AT START, SEEN JITTERY.

text.p: lower on Monday after French left-wing parties took an
unexpectedly strong lead in the first round of elections on
Doubts about the Socialists' stance towards European
economic and monetary union (EMU) were seen keeping investors on
their toes until after the second round on June 1, they said.
"If the socialists win the final vote it could jeopardize
the whole EMU project," one dealer said.
Markka bonds underperformed Bunds and the spread widened to
33 basis points from Friday's 29 basis points.
The second wave of reaction to the French vote was seen on
Tuesday when London and the U.S. reopened.
The markka was a shade softer against the mark in line with
other crosses as many investors rejigged their positions on
fears that EMU may not materialise in time, forex dealers said.
They expected DEM/FIM to trade in a 3.01-3.03 range today.
